description: Modernize the export_tx script to match import_csv capabilities, adding wallet filtering, date ranges, dry-run preview, and better CLI usability
principles: Minimal scope - Focus on wallet filtering as primary improvement
Pattern consistency - Follow import_csv CLI patterns
Backward compatible - All new parameters optional
Security first - Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
User-friendly - Clear help text and dry-run preview

userStories.title: Add wallet filtering to CryptoAccounts.export_transactions_csv()
acceptanceCriteria: Modify export_transactions_csv() signature to accept wallet parameter
Add start_date and end_date parameters for date range filtering
Update SQL query to use WHERE exchange = :wallet when wallet provided
Add date range filtering with WHERE createddate >= :start_date AND createddate <= :end_date
Use parameterized queries for all filters
Maintain backward compatibility (all new parameters optional with None defaults)
Return same tuple format: (column_names, transactions)
Preserve existing coin filtering behavior

userStories.title: Modernize export_tx CLI with argparse
acceptanceCriteria: Replace sys.argv parsing with argparse
Add --wallet option for wallet/exchange filtering
Add --coin option for cryptocurrency filtering
Add --start-date option (YYYY-MM-DD format)
Add --end-date option (YYYY-MM-DD format)
Add --dry-run option for preview without exporting
Add -h/--help with formatted examples
OUTPUT_FILE becomes optional positional argument (default: ledger_export.csv)
Validate date format before passing to export method
Exit code 0 for success, 1 for user errors, 2 for export errors
Show helpful error messages for invalid dates or parameters

userStories.title: Implement dry-run preview
acceptanceCriteria: When --dry-run specified, query transactions but don't write file
Display applied filters (wallet, coin, date range)
Show first 5 transactions in formatted table
Display summary statistics: total count, date range, exchange breakdown
Exit with code 0 after preview (don't proceed to export)
Table format: Date | Type | Buy | Sell | Exchange
Use consistent column widths for readability

All tests passing with zero regressions
